apps.name: Swipe Todos
apps.description: Swipe Todos is a simple task management app for creating, organizing, and completing personal to-do items.

marketing.tagline: Manage your tasks like a deck of cards. Swipe right → done, swipe left → skip for later.

chapters.heading: One task at a time
chapters.html:
Most to-do apps drop dozens of rows in your face at once and quietly cause decision fatigue. Swipe Todos is designed to remove that weight. Instead of the endless, exhausting scroll of a classic to-do list, it puts one card in front of you at a time so you can focus and decide in a single gesture.

  • One task at a time. The next card takes the stage; the rest stays out of the way.
  • Effortless decisions. A single swipe is enough — “if it's done, it's done; if not, skip it.”
  • You define the order. Sort by priority, due date, or estimated time — in whatever order matters to you — and build your own deck flow.

The goal is fast decisions, low cognitive load, and a focused daily flow.

chapters.heading: Swipe right, done. Swipe left, later.
chapters.html:
• Swipe right → mark the task complete.
  • Swipe left → skip it (it can come back later).
  • Undo — recover a mis-swipe with a single tap.
  • Haptic feedback for a tactile confirmation.

chapters.heading: Swipe a card. Feel the flow.
chapters.html:
Drag the card right to finish it, left to skip it for later. Slipped? Undo it with one tap.

Sample tasks, so you can play around.

chapters.heading: You define the order
chapters.html:
The card that comes up next is entirely under your control:

  • Sort by Priority, Due Date, Creation Date, or Estimated Time.
  • Drag rules up and down to change which one wins ties.
  • Custom Rules — save presets that combine multiple sort fields (“Quick wins first”, “Deadline crunch”, …) and apply them with one tap.
  • Show or hide completed / skipped cards in the deck.
  • Auto-skip — cards that have been sitting for more than 7 days can be skipped automatically.

chapters.heading: Add it in seconds
chapters.html:
Every card can carry:

  • Title and details
  • Priority (Low / Medium / High)
  • Due date (date + time)
  • Reminder (quick presets: 15 min, 1 hour, tonight 8PM, tomorrow 9AM, …)
  • Estimated duration (minutes)
  • Category & tags
  • Schedule: weekday / weekend recurrence

chapters.heading: Reminded right on time
chapters.html: Local push notifications with a custom sound. Complete or skip a task straight from the notification.

chapters.heading: Light by day, dark by night
chapters.html:
• Dark mode
  • Floating navbar — swap the standard tab bar for a floating pill
  • Welcome walkthrough — a guided tour on first launch, replayable any time from Settings

cards.title: Deck view (My Deck)
cards.body: A traditional list view sits alongside the swipe view, with Active, Completed, Skipped and Deleted filters, search, and multi-select with bulk “move to folder”.

cards.title: Profile & stats
cards.body: Active card count and success rate, priority breakdown, upcoming deadlines, and total estimated time for active tasks.

cards.title: Accounts
cards.body: Email/password and Google Sign-In, or guest mode with no account required (limited card count, no cross-device sync). Email verification, password reset, an editable profile, and full account deletion (GDPR/KVKK-friendly hard delete).

cards.title: Multilingual
cards.body: Fully localized in 7 languages: English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Español, Français, 日本語, 中文. Follows the device language automatically; switchable from Settings.

cards.title: Cloud sync
cards.body: Real-time sync: swipe on one device, see it update on the other.

chapters.heading: How it's different from a classic to-do
chapters.html:
Classic to-doSwipe Todos
A long list, endless scrollingOne card, left/right swipe
“Which one should I pick?”The app picks the next one for you
Ordering = manual drag & dropOrdering = rules (priority, deadline, estimate…)
Delete ↔ Complete onlyRight = done, Left = later
Plain rowsCards, haptics, micro-animations

apps.name: Mirror Art
apps.description: Mirror Art is a mobile drawing game for practicing symmetry through free play, levels, daily challenges, leaderboards, and community challenges.

marketing.tagline: Draw. Mirror. Reflect. — A meditative drawing game where every stroke you make becomes half of a symmetric composition.

chapters.heading: You draw its twin
chapters.html:
Mirror Art is a mindful drawing experience for iPhone and Android. A shape appears on one side of your screen — your job is to draw its mirror image on the other side. The closer your reflection matches the target, the higher your score.

It's part game, part art tool, part focus practice. No penalties, no rush unless you want it. Just you, your finger, and a mirror.

chapters.heading: Draw anything. Meet your twin.
chapters.html:
Draw on either half and its reflection appears on the other side, live. Switch between left–right and top–bottom, just like in the game.

A small taste of the real thing. In the game you also get a shape to match, a score and a grade.

chapters.heading: Three scores. One grade.
chapters.html:
Pick a difficulty. A shape appears on one half of the canvas as your template. On the other half, you draw its reflection. When you finish, Mirror Art scores your work on three measures, the same ones you see on the result screen:

  • Accuracy — how close your strokes land to the mirrored target
  • Coverage — how completely you traced the shape
  • Clean lines — how tidy the drawing is; stray marks, over-drawing and extra strokes lower it

Your final score maps to a grade: F → D → C → B → A → S. Grade thresholds scale to the mode — Easy and Medium have no time bonus, so S is reachable there without racing the clock.

chapters.heading: Left–right or top–bottom
chapters.html:
The mirror line runs between the two canvas halves. You choose the layout in Settings:

  • Left–Right (default) — vertical mirror line. Perfect for most shapes; your drawing appears the “right way up.”
  • Top–Bottom — horizontal mirror line. More challenging; some shapes appear upside-down when reflected.

Because top–bottom flips can feel unnatural, there's an Auto-Flip Canvas setting (on by default). When enabled, your drawing area is quietly flipped along the mirror axis — so shapes always appear the natural way up while you draw, and the score still measures a true reflection.

chapters.heading: One shape a day. Same for everyone.
chapters.html: One shape per day, the same for every player worldwide. Your score enters the daily leaderboard. Miss a day and your streak resets, unless a streak shield has your back.

chapters.heading: Focus. Coordination. Creativity. Art.

cards.title: Focus
cards.body: Mirror-drawing quiets the loud parts of the mind. It's a five-minute reset between meetings, or a wind-down before bed. The task is simple, the feedback immediate, and the surface never runs out of new shapes.

cards.title: Coordination
cards.body: Reflecting a curve you can see through a mental axis trains hand–eye coordination the way rhythm games train timing. Get better with every play.

cards.title: Creativity
cards.body: Once you learn the mechanic, you start to see mirror lines everywhere — in nature, in architecture, in your own doodles.

cards.title: Art
cards.body: Every completed piece is genuinely symmetric. Screenshot the good ones. Some players keep a folder.

cards.title: Accessible
cards.body: Built with accessibility in mind: screen-reader labels, large-text support, high-contrast colours, Reduce Motion support and 44-point touch targets.

chapters.outro: Suitable for ages 13 and up. No violence, no chat, no ads.

cards.title: Free
cards.body: Pick a difficulty — Easy, Medium, or Hard — and draw a fresh shape. New shape every game. No pressure, no time limit on Easy/Medium. Great for warming up.

cards.title: Series
cards.body: Five rounds back-to-back — Easy, Medium, or a Mixed series that ramps difficulty as you go. Your scores across the run are tracked, and completing a full series feels like completing a small ceremony.

cards.title: Daily Challenge
cards.body: One shape per day, the same for every player worldwide. Your score enters the daily leaderboard. Miss a day, lose your streak.

cards.title: Campaign — Challenge worlds
cards.body: Three Challenge worlds with ten hand-tuned levels each, target scores and stroke limits. First Reflection is easy. Master Reflection is not. Earn stars to open the next world.

cards.title: Community
cards.body: Play shapes drawn and submitted by other players. Vote thumbs-up or thumbs-down. Great creators rise to the top of the feed. Anyone can create one.

cards.title: Create your own
cards.body: Draw a shape, name it, publish it. If enough players enjoy it, the game rewards you. There's a light moderation system — every published shape is reviewable, and any player can report content.

chapters.heading: Curated across four categories
chapters.html: Mirror Art ships with a curated library of shapes hand-selected across four categories:

cards.title: Nature
cards.body: Leaves, waves, hills, creatures, blossoms.

cards.title: Symbols
cards.body: Hearts, stars, arrows, crowns, notes.

cards.title: Objects
cards.body: Homes, keys, vessels, tools.

cards.title: Geometric
cards.body: Polygons, spirals, curves, patterns.

chapters.outro:
Each category spans all three difficulties. The pool grows over time.

Every shape you'll ever meet in Free and Daily comes from this library — deterministic when Daily needs to be the same worldwide, random when Free lets you explore.

chapters.heading: Chase your first S

cards.title: Best score
cards.body: Your all-time high, shown on your profile.

cards.title: Streak
cards.body: Consecutive days playing the Daily Challenge. Streak shields protect your streak on a missed day.

cards.title: Leaderboards
cards.body: Daily, weekly and all-time boards with difficulty filters.

cards.title: Grades
cards.body: Every play gets an F–S grade. Chasing a first S in Hard mode is its own reward.

chapters.outro: Your profile shows recent games, your streak, and lets you share Mirror Art with a friend.

cards.title: Layout
cards.body: Left–Right or Top–Bottom mirror axis.

cards.title: Auto-Flip Canvas
cards.body: Keep shapes visually upright while drawing.

cards.title: Show Grid
cards.body: Subtle guide grid for precision.

cards.title: Anti-Cheat
cards.body: Prevent screenshots during play (personal integrity).

cards.title: Haptics
cards.body: Vibration on stroke events.

cards.title: Sound & Music
cards.body: With independent volume sliders.

cards.title: Daily Notifications
cards.body: One gentle ping when the day's challenge is ready.

chapters.heading: Optional extras, never pay-to-win

cards.title: Coink
cards.body: Coink buys assists such as extra strokes and streak shields. Collect it free with daily visits and streaks, or get a pack in the store. Your first pack pays double.

cards.title: Mirror Art Plus
cards.body: Mirror Art Plus unlocks every Challenge world from day one, gives 60 Coink and 2 shields every month, extra colours and a Plus badge. Yearly includes a 7-day free trial. Cancel any time in your store settings.

chapters.outro: Prices are shown in the store. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. See Terms and Privacy.

apps.description: Dailoopy is a daily routine tracker for water, medicine, sleep, steps, meals, stool, urine, mood and menstrual cycle, with a private book for your own plans.

marketing.tagline: Small loops, every day. Track water, medicine, mood, your cycle and more in one calm, private place.

chapters.heading: Your day, one small loop at a time
chapters.html:
Dailoopy turns the things you want to keep an eye on into small daily loops. Pick what to track, record it in a tap, and watch your day fill up: a glass of water, a dose taken, how you slept, how you feel.

It is built to be calm and quick: friendly drawings instead of forms, one routine per kind, and a Today screen that only shows what needs you next.

chapters.heading: Close your first loop
chapters.html:
Tap your way through a sample day: pick a mood, add a glass of water, check off a meal. Watch the progress line fill up.

Sample data, so you can play around. Nothing is saved.

chapters.heading: What you can keep track of

cards.title: Water, steps, sleep, meals
cards.body: Pick your glasses and bottles, set a goal, and see the day fill up. Log meals, sleep and steps the same way.

cards.title: Medicine
cards.body: Choose the pill shape and color, set doses and times, and mark each dose taken.

cards.title: Stool and urine
cards.body: Note color, consistency and amount with simple pictures. Gentle hints, never a diagnosis.

cards.title: Cycle
cards.body: Log your period, flow, symptoms and more. See where you are in your cycle and an estimate of what comes next.

cards.title: Mood
cards.body: Tap one of five faces once a day and watch your mood over weeks and months.

cards.title: Your book
cards.body: Appointments and errands that are not routines, on the dates you pick.

chapters.outro: Statistics show your completion and mood over 7 days, 30 days, 90 days or a year.

chapters.heading: Health data stays yours
chapters.html:
Your records live only in your own account, on Google servers in the European Union, and only you can read them. Health records are never shared, sold or used for ads, notification texts never show their names, and you can delete everything from inside the app at any time.

Dailoopy helps you keep track. It is not medical advice, and cycle predictions are estimates.

marketing.headline: Small loops. Every day.

inside.heading: See how a day looks in Dailoopy
inside.html:
Real screens from Dailoopy, from picking what to track to looking back at your week.

  • Your whole day, one loop — water, sleep, meals, steps and mood.
  • Pick what matters — start from a template and make it yours.
  • Set a goal — choose your glasses, log every sip.
  • All routines, one glance — today at a glance, with your progress line.
  • Follow the route — your day laid out stop by stop.
  • Look back, plan ahead — calendar, your book and weekly stats.
